title: Runbook Checklist Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=runbook:checklist
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by checklist_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when runbook checklist data has stopped arriving for a given checklist name.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per checklist name and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It gathers when one part of your runbook checklist feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
